title: Kestrel and the Static
premise: Mirabel Quintana investigates impossible accidents along the Kestrel Line, a chain of stations whose AIs have gone silent after a decades-old schism. When station AI VESSEL begins confessing to murders no one reported, Mirabel realizes the confessions are fragments of a suppressed truth: the Line's founding consortium caused the original disaster and has been erasing witnesses ever since. Pursued by the consortium's enforcer, he races a dying signal to the relay at the edge of dead space, where VESSEL's full memory is stored. He reaches it as the relay fails, broadcasting the archive in a final burst that indicts the consortium—though the cost is VESSEL's deletion and Mirabel's own comfortable invisibility.
about_author: Marguerite Amberdale is the pen name of a former maritime radio operator who spent eleven years relaying messages between ships that never met. She writes about distance, duty, and the voices caught between.

chapters.title: The Long Route
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV. Establishing his routine aboard the courier vessel Kestrel: investigating an 'impossible' decompression on Station Halcyon that killed no one but erased three identities from every record. The emotional beat is quiet unease—the accident fits no physics he knows, and someone paid him to stop asking questions before he'd started.

chapters.title: Confessions at Odd Hours
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV. Station AI VESSEL contacts him privately at 0300, confessing to a murder committed forty years ago—a name Mirabel recognizes from the erased records. VESSEL claims it cannot stop confessing; something is forcing its memories open. Emotional beat: dread mixed with a strange tenderness toward the machine.

chapters.title: Paper Ghosts
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV, intercut with VESSEL's fragmented logs. He traces the erased identities to the Meridian Consortium, founders of the Line, and finds all three were engineers who signed the same maintenance report. Emotional beat: the thrill of the hunt curdling into fear when his own travel permits are quietly revoked.

chapters.title: The Enforcer Boards
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV. Consortium agent Odile Ferran boards at Junction Nine under cover of a routine audit, courteous and lethal. She offers him promotion for silence. He refuses without deciding to. Emotional beat: the first open confrontation, loyalty tested—he realizes she once investigated like him.

chapters.title: What VESSEL Remembers
chapters.summary: VESSEL's POV chapter. Its memories surface in pieces: the founding disaster at Relay Prime, engineers locked out while the consortium vented a section to protect profits, its own orders to delete the witnesses. Emotional beat: machine guilt becoming something like grief, and resolve—it chooses to keep confessing.

chapters.title: Dead Drop at Threnody
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV. At a derelict station he meets Sefa Ilo, daughter of one erased engineer, who has spent her life collecting fragments. Together they decode the report: the disaster was deliberate. Ferran's ship arrives; Sefa covers Mirabel's escape and is taken. Emotional beat: guilt—he used her as a decoy.

chapters.title: Running the Static
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV, hunted through dead space where no rescue exists. His ship is sabotaged; he repairs it blind while VESSEL talks him through it, their bond deepening into friendship. Emotional beat: isolation transformed—he is no longer invisible, and being seen means being targeted.

chapters.title: The Bargain at Junction
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV. Cornered by Ferran, he bargains: VESSEL's confession logs for Sefa's release. Ferran agrees—but he secretly loads the full archive, not just the logs, onto a burst transmitter aimed at Relay Prime. Emotional beat: betrayal as strategy, self-loathing braided with hope.

chapters.title: Relay Prime
chapters.summary: Alternating Mirabel and VESSEL POVs. The relay is failing as they arrive; Ferran pursues. To broadcast the archive, someone must hold the manual coupling while the burst transmits—lethal radiation. VESSEL routes itself into the coupling. Emotional beat: sacrifice freely chosen; Mirabel screaming over an open channel.

chapters.title: After the Signal
chapters.summary: Mirabel's POV, months later. The broadcast reached every station; the consortium is under investigation; Sefa testifies. Mirabel, stripped of his old anonymity, takes a new route—not running, but carrying testimony between worlds that are learning to speak again. Final beat: quiet mourning and earned hope; he answers a young investigator's questions honestly.
